title: SMOK RPM 5 Replacement Pods 2ml
description: These replacement, refillable pods for the RPM 5 can hold 2ml of your favourite e-liquid, and refilling is made simple and mess-free with its top-refill design which also prevents leaks. The pods are built for SMOK’s RPM 3 mesh coils, built for awesome flavour and longevity. Versatile, compact and incredibly satisfying to use, the new RPM 5 pod kit from Smok is an ideal kit for all types of vaper.
